Aircraft feed

Custom feed URL

Takes readsb / tar1090 / dump1090 aircraft.json, ADSBx-v2 or OpenSky JSON. Placeholders: {lat} {lon} {radius} {lamin} {lamax} {lomin} {lomax}. A home receiver needs HTTPS and CORS.

Refresh

Zoomed-out views stitch several requests together and refresh more slowly to respect each feed's limits.

Aircraft: adsb.lol (ODbL), airplanes.live, adsb.fi, OpenSky Network. Routes and airframes: adsbdb, hexdb.io. Flight tracks: OpenSky Network. Photos: Planespotters.net, Airport-Data.com, Wikipedia (credited per photo). Weather radar: RainViewer. Airport weather: Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0). Map: OpenFreeMap © OpenMapTiles, data © OpenStreetMap contributors, drawn with MapLibre. Optional tiles © CARTO. Built-in map: Natural Earth. Airports: OurAirports.
Free community feeds for personal, non-commercial use, with no uptime guarantee. Routes are crowd-sourced and can be out of date.
